title: VeloraOS 1.10.37 - Qwen2.5 Runtime Stability Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes the first real Qwen2.5 3B turn appearing to hang after an instant greeting.
Uses the standard Ollama chat request for Qwen2.5 instead of sending thinking-model controls.
Keeps short prompts fast with adaptive output budgets even when Cosmic Reasoning is set high.
Adds bounded model-call watchdogs so a stuck Ollama request cannot leave Chat locked for many minutes.
Surfaces model-call failures inline and unlocks Chat immediately for a retry.
Expands instant social handling for polite variants such as asking how VeloraOS is.
